item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Amorphizing halide cathodes (LiVCl4, LiTaOCl4) minimizes grain-boundary ion-transport barriers rather than maximizing bulk conductivity, enabling catholyte-free ASSLBs with 90 wt% CAM. This yields 75C operation (102.1 mAh g–1 at 20 mA cm–2), 16,000-cycle stability, and wide-temperature performance, establishing conformal amorphous interfaces as a new paradigm for ultrahigh-power all-solid-state lithium batteries.

item.title: Cascade Desolvation and Conversion Reaction Driven by Self‐Tandem Catalysis for Wide‐Temperature Li‐S Batteries
item.description:
کاتالیز خودتندمی با Ce اتمی روی LDH غنی از نقص، واکنش‌های آبگیری Li+ و تبدیل پلی‌سولفید را تسریع کرده و باتری Li-S را در دمای 0 تا -30 درجه سانتی‌گراد کارآمد می‌سازد.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using atom-level Ce on defect-rich CoFe-LDH as a self-tandem catalyst to enable cascade Li+ desolvation and polysulfide conversion, avoiding electrolyte engineering. This lowers reaction barriers, boosting kinetics and enabling stable wide-temperature Li-S batteries (0 to −30°C) with 94% retention at 5C, offering a promising strategy for high-performance wide-temperature LSBs.
🏷 Li-S battery · wide-temperature · self-tandem catalysis · desolvation · polysulfide conversion
